## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. **One-off job pattern.** `ops/exec_host.toml` (`sig.exec-host/1`) +
   `ops/src/ops/exec_host.py` + `sig-ops exec-host plan|render|run|
   verify-describe|smoke` + `ops/gcp/exec-host.sh`: an ephemeral
   `sig-exec-<purpose>-<stamp>` Cloud Run job — digest-pinned image
   (ADR-111), `sig-quality-probe-rt`, read-only gcsfuse mount of
   `gs://<project>-sig-restricted` (the workload's captures root is the
   declared `evidence/captures/` prefix), the Cloud SQL connector on
   `sig-pg`, only declared `secret_env` names injected, `--tasks=1`,
   `--max-retries=0`, bounded `task_timeout`, per-execution `--args`, and
   a name-checked `finally` delete of exactly the created job (a
   `sig-exec-*` job at rest is reported as leaked cleanup by `iam diff`).
   Used by P34.45, P34.49, P35.61.
2. **`sig_audit` login (L1; SIG-CONF-013).** `ops/src/ops/db_logins.py` +
   `ops/gcp/db-logins.sh` + the `audit_login` sqitch change: LOGIN,
   `NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS`, connlimit 4, member
   of `sig_read_public`, `default_transaction_read_only = on`,
   `statement_timeout = 60s`; credential = a generated password held only
   in Secret Manager `sig-audit-password` (HG-09 — the IAM-DB-auth
   alternative rejected, recorded in ADR-202). A smoke run writes one
   `sig.probe-run/1` record under `ops/probes/` (P34.44a owns the harness
   writer).
3. **NEW-16 table grants.** `db/deploy/audit_login.sql` (appended after
   L59 — L44–52 byte-identical, C-10) grants `sig_audit` SELECT on
   `ingest_run_capture` + `entity_identity_key` — catalog/grant-only,
   guarded, revert/verify paired. Hosted deploy waits inside P34.46's
   slot; until then the checks needing those tables report
   `not_evaluable`, never a false pass or a false failure.
4. **`sig_recovery_login` (L2, `live:P34.46`).** A constrained LOGIN
   (connlimit 2) granted membership in the pre-existing `sig_recovery`
   NOLOGIN group (L52) — the login name differs deliberately to keep the
   group role shape; credential `sig-recovery-password`. The leg reads
   `pg_roles` and **exits 42** when the group role is absent.
5. **Verification.** `db-login verify` proves: login posture, the four
   NO* flags, connlimit, session defaults, memberships, the
   `sig_read_public` read surface, NEW-16 `not_evaluable` until deployed,
   and refused-write probes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE). The exec
   leg's `analysis` action proves the read-only posture via policy
   troubleshooter — `storage.objects.create` under `evidence/captures/`
   and `storage.objects.delete` anywhere on the bucket NOT_GRANTED, and
   no access to unrelated secrets.

## Plan

- `ops/exec_host.toml` — `sig.exec-host/1`: `sig-exec` family, SA
  `sig-quality-probe-rt`, `image_repo=sig-api`, `command=sh` (the shared
  image has no ENTRYPOINT; `--command` at create, `--args` per
  execution), one task / no retries / 3600 s, the `sig-pg` Cloud SQL
  connector, read-only mount `/mnt/captures` of
  `<project>-sig-restricted` at `evidence/captures/`,
  `probe_prefix=ops/probes/`, declared `secret_env` allow-list
  (`SIG_AUDIT_PASSWORD` ← `sig-audit-password`, `SIG_RECOVERY_PASSWORD` ←
  `sig-recovery-password`).
- `ops/src/ops/exec_host.py` — fail-closed loader + `plan`/`render`
  (pure argv: `jobs create` with `--command`, service-account, tasks,
  retries, timeout, `--add-volume …,readonly=true` + `--add-volume-mount`,
  `--set-cloudsql-instances`, `--set-secrets`, `--set-env-vars` incl.
  `SIG_EXEC_JOB_NAME` from the generated name — never caller input),
  `run` (create → `execute --wait` → name-checked `delete` in a
  `finally`), `verify-describe` (a recorded describe JSON vs the
  declaration: image pinned, one task, maxRetries 0, timeout, SA, the
  captures volume `readOnly` CSI flag, the Cloud SQL instance, only
  declared secrets), `smoke` (in-container: mount readonly asserted by
  `/proc/mounts` + a refuse-write touch, declared env secrets
  present+non-empty, `sig_audit` session posture via `SHOW
  transaction_read_only`/`statement_timeout` + a refused write, then one
  `sig.probe-run/1` object under `ops/probes/`).
- `ops/src/ops/db_logins.py` — `LoginRole` declarative model
  (`sig_audit`, `sig_recovery_login`; `sig_recovery` resolves as an
  alias); `plan`/`apply`/`verify` over `--dsn`/`SIG_DB_LOGIN_DSN`;
  idempotent apply (existing role → skip CREATE, reassert); missing
  prerequisite (the `sig_recovery` group) → exit 42; verify returns
  pass/fail/not_evaluable; passwords only via env (never argv/files/logs).
- `ops/iam_identities.toml` + `iam_identities.py` — `[[oneoff]]` family
  `sig-exec` on `sig-quality-probe-rt`; the `exec` leg scoped to only its
  own steps (SA create, `cloudsql.client`, the two conditioned bucket
  bindings `p34-43-captures-readonly` + `p34-43-probe-records`, the two
  secret accessors); collision validation (a one-off SA can't be a
  service/job identity; names/prefixes fail closed); the jobs leg no
  longer judges exec-owned members; `sig-exec-*` jobs at rest reported
  as leaked cleanup.
- `ops/gcp/exec-host.sh` — the windowed L1 leg:
  `prestate → identity → secrets → bindings → smoke → verify → analysis`
  (+`rollback`, `all`); check-mode default; exit 42 inside the freeze or
  the 03:00–06:30Z band; prestate = project IAM, SAs, run jobs, bucket
  IAM, secret IAM + list, rendered declaration, sha256 sidecars;
  troubleshooter assertions incl. off-prefix create and everywhere
  delete NOT_GRANTED and no `sig-pg-password` access; rollback removes
  only what the leg created/owns (prestate-proven), the created job by
  exact name.
- `ops/gcp/db-logins.sh` — `prestate → backup → apply → credential →
  verify` (+`rollback`, `all`) per `--role`; Cloud SQL Proxy; owner DSN +
  password via env only (SIG_DB_LOGIN_DSN, `${PASSWORD_ENV}`); AR-2

## Deviations

- **OM-16 size:** ~3.1k changed lines excl. generated/fixtures — at/over
  the 3,000 budget (the ticket bundles three legs; a split would have
  separated the sqitch+db-login half from the exec-host half).
- **Migration verify fix:** the first DB run hit `division by zero` at
  `verify/audit_login.sql:71` — the assertion `NOT
  pg_has_role('sig_recovery_login','sig_read_public','USAGE')` collapsed
  because `pg_has_role` reports transitive membership and the L52 group
  surface reaches `sig_read_public` transitively in the full-plan
  posture; rewritten to assert the membership **directly** —
  `pg_auth_members` of `sig_recovery_login` is exactly `{sig_recovery}` —
  which is the honest invariant (the login holds no grant the group
  doesn't confer).
- **ADR-201 append:** its revisit trigger fired (the exec leg adds
  conditioned storage grants on the same bucket) — a `## Status updates`
  note appended, not a body edit.
- **Orient budget:** the RETURN PASS row + phase-log line crossed 48 KiB
  at closeout — the pre-P34.43 head `State.` line archived byte-for-byte
  to `docs/build/reports/memory-repair/LEDGER_head_state_pre-P34.43.txt`
  (sha256 `3d6ca92d…`, pointer comment in the head) per the
  P34.38/P34.41/P34.42a/b precedent (BM-LEDGER-08), then the line
  rewritten compact.
